summary: GPU capacity exhaustion causing queue wait + elevated latency (Hosted API us-east)
description:
Issue summary:
Hosted API requests are queuing for extended periods; p95 > 12s and 503 spikes.

Impact:
Customer-facing impact for hosted tier in us-east; streaming first token slow.

Environment:
prod us-east; shared A100 pool.

Initial signals:
- gpu_pool_free_slots == 0
- scheduler_queue_depth rising

Requested help:
Eng Infra to validate fleet saturation and provisioning rate limits.
comments: 2025-11-07 09:20 PT (Chloe Martin): Paging Eng Infra + SRE. Support reports "no capacity" 503s.
2025-11-07 09:28 PT (Elliot Price): Confirmed GPU free slots at 0 for 12m. Provisioning requests pending; suspect quota cache stale.
2025-11-07 09:41 PT (Grace O'Connor): Routing policy not spilling until queue depth 500; recommend temporary override.
2025-11-07 10:02 PT (Elliot Price): Forced quota cache refresh; capacity recovering. 503s down.
2025-11-18 (Elliot Price): Postmortem published. Follow-ups tracked separately.
resolution: Forced refresh of regional quota cache; temporarily adjusted routing spillover threshold; added burst capacity. Marking resolved and linking postmortem.
